title: Candlelight Dinner Near Bangalore: Date Nights Under the Open Sky
description: Planning a candlelight dinner near Bangalore? Fernway by Stories sets candlelit garden tables every night — a date night spot for couples on the Bangalore–Mysore Expressway.
imageAlt: Garden lights coming on at dusk at Fernway by Stories, a date night spot near Bangalore
keywords: romantic places near Bangalore for couples

sections.heading: Candlelight every night — no special booking needed
paragraphs: At Fernway by Stories, candlelit tables aren't a package you have to pre-book. Every night, the garden is set with candles, warm lights and greenery, so any dinner here can be a candlelight dinner.
It's why couples drive out from Bengaluru for date nights, anniversaries and birthdays: open sky above, no city noise, and nobody rushing you out — we're open till 6am.

sections.heading: The best night for couples: Friday candlelight jamming
paragraphs: If you can only pick one night, pick Friday — {{fridayJam}}. Soft live music, candles on every table and a late dinner make it our most romantic evening of the week.

sections.heading: Make it a date
paragraphs: A few ideas from our team:
list: Arrive around sunset and stay for dinner under the stars
Share North Indian starters, then a slow main course and dessert
Celebrating something? Mention it when you book and we'll help with seating

sections.heading: Getting here
paragraphs: Fernway is in Mayaganahalli on the Bangalore–Mysore Expressway, between Bidadi and Ramanagara — an easy drive out of the city. Reserve a table online or call {{phone}}.
